name: transcript-extractor
description: Development tooling for the transcript-extractor browser extensions. The extensions themselves ship no npm dependencies; this manifest exists only so the test harnesses can be installed reproducibly.

scripts.test: node extensions/youtube/tests/run.mjs && node extensions/youtube/tests/panel.mjs && node extensions/substack/tests/run.mjs && node extensions/stream/tests/run.mjs && node extensions/spotify/tests/run.mjs && node extensions/_shared/tests/run.mjs
scripts.test:local: node extensions/_shared/tests/run.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s tools/local-transcription -p test_*.py
